drop_reason: Distinct meanings cannot be reliably mapped from user-described symptoms; exclusion approved for the final ML and future inference schema.

binary_interpretation.0: not recorded as present; does not establish clinical absence

deduplication: remaining symptom vector AND disease label; keep first in raw source order
conflicting_labels: preserve all distinct labels; never majority-relabel
group_definition: complete remaining symptom vector, excluding disease label and row metadata

constant_features.fit_stage: training phase, inside model pipelines, on training data only

operation_order: exact deduplication on remaining features and label
persist split data and reusable artifacts
test_usage: locked after Phase 2; final evaluation only, never feature or hyperparameter selection
